description: Business events occur all the time in the world and Apache Kafka is the leading technology to store and process these events in real time. In this series of courses, we will guide you through the data in motion universe, starting with what Apache Kafka is, which pieces it comprises, and how to use them effectively to build real-time, data streaming applications.
summary_ja: Kafkaの基礎から実践までを案内する入門コースシリーズ。
title: Apache Kafka® 101

description: Why is Flink useful, and how does it work? This course uses Flink SQL to introduce the core concepts of stream processing with Flink and shows how they fit together to solve real problems.
summary_ja: Flink SQLでストリーム処理の核となる概念を学ぶ入門コース。
title: Apache Flink® 101

description: This is a course about Flink SQL, which is part of the Apache Flink project. Exploring what Flink SQL can do is a great way to get started with Apache Flink and stream processing.
summary_ja: ウィンドウ集計や結合などFlink SQLの実践機能を演習付きで学ぶコース。
title: Apache Flink® SQL

description: Apache Iceberg is a modern, open-source table format for massive analytics datasets in data lakes. It brings database-like capabilities to object storage: ACID transactions, schema evolution, time travel, and hidden partitioning.
summary_ja: データレイク向けテーブル形式Icebergの概念とTableflowを学ぶコース。
title: Apache Iceberg™️

description: Creating and storing events is useful, but being able to react to those events and process them is what is truly transformational to how businesses operate today. When you want the full control over the application logic, Kafka Streams is your go-to stream processing framework.
summary_ja: Kafka Streamsによるストリーム処理アプリ開発の入門コース。
title: Kafka Streams 101

description: If you're a Python developer, this course will show you how to harness the power of Apache Kafka in your applications. You'll learn how to build Kafka producer and consumer applications, how to work with the event schema, and take advantage of the Confluent Schema Registry and more.
summary_ja: PythonクライアントでKafkaアプリを構築する開発者向けコース。
title: Kafka for Python Developers

description: Apache Kafka is a great fit for .NET applications due to its powerful real-time data processing features. Learn how to use Kafka to build a streaming application with .NET.
summary_ja: .NETクライアントでKafkaストリーミングアプリを構築するコース。
title: Apache Kafka® for .NET Developers

description: In the event-driven world, schemas are essential as they can enforce the shape of the data and act as contracts between producers and consumers. The Schema Registry can manage those contracts and allow their evolution in a safe way.
summary_ja: スキーマを契約として管理するSchema Registryの入門コース。
title: Schema Registry 101

description: Kafka Connect is a component of Apache Kafka that's used to perform streaming integration between Kafka and other systems such as databases, cloud services, search indexes, file systems, and key-value stores. Thanks to the strong community behind Kafka, hundreds of connectors are readily available.
summary_ja: Kafkaと外部システムを連携するKafka Connectの入門コース。
title: Kafka Connect 101

description: If you want to get instant insights from your data streams but don't want to go through the hassle of writing a full-fledged application and worry about the infrastructure, then ksqlDB is for you. Just write some good old SQL code and it's processing your business events in real-time.
summary_ja: SQLでストリーム処理を書けるksqlDBの入門コース。
title: ksqlDB 101

description: This course is about building systems with a Streamhouse architecture. A streamhouse is a data architecture that continuously captures, processes, governs, and serves the current state of a business as changes happen—so applications, AI agents, and analytics can use the same fresh, trusted data.
summary_ja: リアルタイム運用層「Streamhouse」アーキテクチャを構築するコース。
title: Building a Streamhouse

description: Step into the future with streaming data! Data engineering traditionally focused on batch processing, however, modern businesses can't afford to wait. Learn how data streaming is reshaping data engineering and how to modernize systems to adapt.
summary_ja: バッチ処理からストリーミングへ移行するデータエンジニアリング実践コース。
title: From Batch to Streaming: Modern Data Engineering Pipelines

description: How do you move from a simple proof of concept to a bulletproof data streaming system that is ready for production deployment? In this course, you will learn how to avoid pitfalls when scaling your data streaming platform. Additionally, you'll delve deep into the GitOps framework.
summary_ja: Kafka基盤を本番運用レベルに引き上げるための実践コース。
title: Mastering Production Data Streaming Systems with Apache Kafka®

description: How about we get our hands dirty and write some code now? Get ready to learn how to develop a robust event streaming application using one of the most widely used Java frameworks. Spring Boot meets Kafka Streams.
summary_ja: Spring BootとKafkaでイベントストリーミングアプリを開発するコース。
title: Spring Framework and Apache Kafka®

description: Microservices are the foundation of Cloud-Native Distributed Systems. Learn the principles of microservices and how they can be extended to build Event-Driven Architectures.
summary_ja: イベント駆動マイクロサービスの設計原則とパターンを学ぶコース。
title: Designing Event-Driven Microservices

description: Storing data as events rather than in relational databases working with traditional rows and columns brings many advantages, like recovering your system quickly by replaying events, a free audit log, or the ability to get better business insights. In this course, you'll learn about how events can be used as the storage model for your applications, what event sourcing is, how it works, and how it relates to approaches like CQRS and CDC.
summary_ja: イベントソーシングとCQRS/CDCをKafkaで学ぶコース。
title: Event Sourcing and Event Storage with Apache Kafka®

description: Earlier, you learned that events are the very foundation of real-time event-streaming applications. This course gives you design tips to craft top-notch events that are uniquely tailored to your business needs.
summary_ja: イベントとイベントストリームの設計手法を学ぶコース。
title: Designing Events and Event Streams

description: Event Modeling is a simple visual method for designing event-driven systems. In this course, learn how to build an event model and implement the modeled system.
summary_ja: イベントモデリングという視覚的設計手法を学び実装するコース。
title: Practical Event Modeling

description: Imagine if anyone had access to the key of your house? Well, it's the same if you don't secure your IT infrastructure and services. Kafka takes security seriously and has incorporated robust security features into all components.
summary_ja: 認証・認可・暗号化などKafkaのセキュリティ機能を学ぶコース。
title: Apache Kafka® Security

description: From Apache Kafka security, authentication, and RBAC, to cloud data security and monitoring, learn how to use Confluent Cloud's security features to meet all your security and compliance needs.
summary_ja: Confluent Cloudの認証・RBAC・暗号化などのセキュリティ機能を学ぶコース。
title: Confluent Cloud Security

description: How to integrate Confluent Cloud with on-prem, public, and private cloud data streaming applications to meet connectivity, privacy, and security requirements.
summary_ja: Confluent Cloudと自社ネットワークの接続方式を学ぶコース。
title: Confluent Cloud Networking

description: In this course, we look at some of the specific Stream Governance features in Confluent Cloud. You will have an opportunity to try out many of these features in the hands-on exercises.
summary_ja: Confluent Cloudのストリームガバナンス機能を演習付きで学ぶコース。
title: Streaming Data Governance

description: In this video series you learn about Client-side Field-level Encryption (CSFLE). In addition to getting an introduction about this powerful technology, allowing you to encrypt specific fields of a Kafka message, you also learn about the underlying encryption technology, envelope encryption. Lastly, this series also includes an end-to-end demo walking you through the steps of configuring CSFLE.
summary_ja: Kafkaメッセージのフィールド単位暗号化（CSFLE）を学ぶ動画シリーズ。
title: Client-side Field-level Encryption (CSFLE)

description: We believe it's important to know how a piece of technology works under the hood to understand its consistency, performance, security, and scalability characteristics. This course describes the architecture of Apache Kafka with lectures from Jun Rao, one of its original authors and a Confluent co-founder.
summary_ja: Kafkaの内部アーキテクチャを共同創業者が解説するコース。
title: Apache Kafka® Internal Architecture

description: ksqlDB looks like magic when you first use it, so let's take a tour and discover how it's been built with ease-of-use in mind but also security, scalability and performance.
summary_ja: ksqlDBの内部構造とアーキテクチャを掘り下げるコース。
title: Inside ksqlDB

description: A series of videos and hands-on exercises that will show how to use Flink to interact with Kafka topics as though they were relational database tables, using the Flink Table API in Java — no SQL knowledge required.
summary_ja: JavaのTable APIでKafkaトピックをテーブルのように処理するFlinkコース。
title: Apache Flink® Table API: Processing Data Streams in Java

description: This course will introduce students to Apache Flink through a series of hands-on exercises. Students will build a basic application in Java that will consume a collection of Apache Kafka data streams. The data will be transformed using Flink and pushed back into new Kafka topics.
summary_ja: JavaのDataStream APIでFlinkアプリを構築するハンズオンコース。
title: Building Apache Flink Applications in Java
